name: Kawasumi Hotaru
source: A cheerful and friendly middle school girl. She's the class president and works hard to be popular. She has a crush on her old elementary school teacher Tsukasa-sensei who is a guest at the teacher recruitment test. Wants to be seen as mature for Tsukasa-sensei but is worried he'll get the wrong idea because of the lewd things she's doing as part of the test.
